basis: Guest Settings cases other than those already passed in docs/stabilization/runs/render-retest-001.json; no runtime work performed in this preparation lane.
resource_lease: Root-provided lease must be recorded by the executing owner before UI work; this source-only preparation started no process and acquired no lease.
build_reload_version_gate: Use a fresh completed development-build receipt for the exact source being tested.
In Chrome Extensions, verify the existing dev extension ID cihdmkcdjjckfhjpgoedmgfpoljebaml is enabled and its version equals the receipt; confirm the loaded unpacked path is the receipt path.

Reload the extension, reopen Settings, and verify the displayed About version and Chrome Extensions version still match the receipt. If the installed version is stale or the panel fails to render, stop and record setup/blocker evidence; make no case verdicts.
timing_method: For each action, capture Date.now() immediately before the user/UI action; after the resulting accessibility-tree state is read, capture Date.now() again. Record the difference as automation-inclusive elapsed time (action-to-AX observation), explicitly not pure UI latency. Keep per-action raw timestamps and do not infer performance from this measure.

steps: Open Settings > Organization.
Observe the guest state without signing in or attempting a backend request.
expected: Guest sees the source-defined 'Sign in to choose' organization state; no organization selector is offered.

steps: Open Settings > Chat while remaining signed out and without an active organization.
Observe the default-agent control area.
expected: The agent picker is absent; source renders 'Choose an organization above'. No agent or organization request is triggered.

cases.control: Guest denial/absence of Advanced agent capabilities
steps: Open Settings and inspect the section list for Advanced agent capabilities.
Do not invoke the admin component directly or alter role state.
expected: The admin-gated section is absent for a guest.

steps: Record initial open/closed state for each visible group.
Open and close each group in turn; verify its content appears and hides with the trigger state.
expected: Visible groups toggle open and closed, with content visibility matching the trigger state.
cases.cleanup: Restore each group's recorded initial state; do not change any nested preference.

cases.control: Share page identity & email content preference
steps: Record the initial switch state.
Toggle once and verify its checked state; navigate to Chat and back to verify persistence.
Restore the recorded state and verify it.
expected: The switch reflects the selected value and persists through view navigation.
cases.cleanup: Restore the original value. Do not inspect or transmit page identity or email content.

cases.control: Offer saved logins on sign-in forms preference
steps: Record the initial switch state.
Toggle once and verify the checked state; navigate away and back to verify persistence.
Restore the recorded state and verify it.
expected: The switch reflects the selected value and persists through view navigation.
cases.cleanup: Restore the original value. Do not use a real sign-in form or invoke credential matching.

cases.control: Show password suggestions on websites preference

Toggle once and verify On-page/quiet state; navigate away and back to verify persistence.

expected: The switch changes the preference between on_page and quiet and persists through view navigation.
cases.cleanup: Restore the original state. Do not open a credential form or expose credentials.

steps: Record the initial switch state and verify the visible 'coming soon' hint.
Toggle once, verify state; navigate away and back to verify persistence.
Restore the recorded state and verify it.
expected: Switch state persists and the control remains visibly identified as coming soon.
cases.cleanup: Restore the original value; do not claim deep-clean behavior from the setting toggle alone.

steps: Record the initial mode.
Select Capture, reload the extension, and verify Capture remains selected.
Select Scroll & capture, reload, and verify it remains selected.
expected: Each mode remains selected after extension reload.
cases.cleanup: Restore the initial mode and verify it after reload. This case verifies the preference only; it does not infer capture quality from a short static page.

remaining_guest_settings_needing_auth_in.dependency: Guest view states are testable signed out; organization selection and populated agent picker require authenticated membership and organization integration.
Visible preference toggles are locally testable; proving login-save or password-suggestion behavior requires a controlled sign-in-form fixture and credential-safe flow.
Audit-key view/export/filter interactions are inside the admin-only section and require authenticated admin UI; key rotation is destructive and excluded from this guest batch.
Desktop pairing/engine port require desktop bridge integration; do not enter fabricated pairing credentials or disrupt a real bridge.
Clear-local-data confirmation includes destructive deletion/sign-out; excluded, including confirm path.
Sign-in requires an approved auth session/provider flow; no auth state change in this batch.
Optional Chrome permission grants require admin UI and explicit permission prompts; excluded from guest execution.
Requires a pre-seeded Never ask origin; needs a controlled origin fixture and cleanup to restore the original list.

Preference is locally testable; verifying automatic scrape or Scroll & capture behavior needs a discriminating long-page fixture. Prior identical example.com text is inconclusive and must not be reported as failure.

excluded_or_not_guest_visible.reason: Admin-only UI or privileged permission/key actions; no guest visibility is asserted.
Destructive local reset excluded, including confirmation path.
Pairing would mutate integration state; no fabricated token or bridge change.
